project_type: Monorepo npm workspaces: NestJS 11 + Prisma 7 API (apps/api), Next.js 16 App Router + Tailwind + shadcn/ui web (apps/web), typed OpenAPI client (packages/api-client)
build_system: npm workspaces. Root scripts delegate to workspaces. Prisma client is generated into apps/api/src/generated/prisma. api-client is generated from OpenAPI then compiled to dist, which apps/web imports.
test_framework: Jest for backend unit/service tests (apps/api, jest.config.ts). Playwright for E2E (needs running stack; NOT used for this task).
build_command: Backend: `npm run build:api`. Web: `npm run build:web`. api-client: `npm run build:api-client`.
test_command: All backend: `npm run test:unit`. One file: `npm run test --workspace apps/api -- <specfile>.spec.ts`.
verification_instructions: After backend changes: `npm run typecheck:api` then `npm run test --workspace apps/api -- <changed>.spec.ts` (single-run, never watch). After DTO/endpoint changes you MUST regenerate the contract: `npm run contracts:generate` (runs openapi:generate -> api-client:generate), then `npm run build:api-client` so apps/web sees new schemas. Web: `npm run typecheck:web`, `npm run build:web`. Final: `npm run typecheck` (api + api-client + web), `npm run build:api`, `npm run build:web`, `npm run test:unit`.
snapshot_or_generated_files: apps/api/openapi/openapi.json (produced by `npm run openapi:generate`) and packages/api-client/src/generated/schema.d.ts (produced by `npm run api-client:generate`). Both are checked in and MUST be regenerated after changing DTOs/endpoints via `npm run contracts:generate`; then `npm run build:api-client` to refresh dist. Prisma client regen is NOT needed (no schema change).
environment_constraints: No new dependencies (no xlsx/exceljs — CSV is built client-side with a UTF-8 BOM). ValidationPipe global is strict: whitelist:true AND forbidNonWhitelisted:true (apps/api/src/app.config.ts) so any undeclared property in an imported document -> 400. TypeScript strict; avoid `any` without justification. Do not break existing repo commands.
contribution_requirements: Steering 00/10/20/30: Prisma only in backend; business rules only in backend; frontend only consumes REST + cosmetic gating; validate external input via DTO (class-validator); use real package.json scripts (no invented commands); test business rules/permissions/validations/errors; must typecheck + pass tests before done.
key_patterns: Service methods resolve scope via PlanStateService.requirePlanInScope and mutate inside this.prisma.$transaction with AuditService.record(tx, {...}) using scopeProcessId = request.mainProcessId. applyMilestoneRule returns normalized {estimateHours,startDate,endDate}. Cycle check today is per-edge reachability (DFS from predecessor). DTOs use @ApiProperty/@ApiPropertyOptional + class-validator + a local trim Transform. Frontend lib modules expose PlanError + messageForStatus + {data,error,response} handling; downloadMarkdown shows the Blob + <a download> + revokeObjectURL pattern. Tests mock Prisma delegates and pass $transaction through (cb => cb(prismaObj)).
relevant_files: apps/api/src/modules/plan/plan.service.spec.ts (extend createMocks + add export/import tests; STYLE REFERENCE)
directory_structure: apps/api/src/modules/plan: plan.{controller,service,module}.ts, plan-state.service.ts, dto/, dependency/{dependency.service.ts,cycle.ts(new),dto/}, phase/{phase.service.ts,dto/}, task/{task.service.ts,milestone.ts(new),dto/}. apps/web/src/lib: plan.ts, tasks.ts, documents.ts, api-client.ts. apps/web/src/app/seguimiento/plan: plan-view.tsx. Generated contract: apps/api/openapi/openapi.json, packages/api-client/src/generated/schema.d.ts.
